$description: Regional, never alarmist. One reminder per card. Dates are windows the client can schedule around; nothing here is a claim about weather this year.

items.headline: Monsoon season
items.text: Wind, dust and flash flooding are the summer claims in the desert basins. Flood damage is not part of a standard home policy; it is a separate policy. Worth knowing before the first storm.

items.headline: Wildfire season
items.text: If you live near the wildland edge, check the dwelling limit on your home policy against what it would cost to rebuild today, not what you paid.

items.headline: Freeze warnings
items.text: Burst pipes are a winter claim in the mountain towns. Most home policies cover sudden pipe failure but not the damage that comes from leaving heat off in a vacant house.

items.headline: Medicare open enrollment
items.text: The window to change a Medicare Advantage or Part D plan runs October 15 to December 7. Reviewing the plan you have is a fair outcome. Changing it is not the goal.
